description: restore_snapshot rejects a snapshot payload carrying the same struct field twice. Uses request_raw because a serde_json::Value round-trip collapses duplicate keys, which is the behavior under test. Before HEU-743 the handler routed params through a Value and this restored, keeping the last value. Protocol 8 carries the change. Paired with the undeserializable and inconsistent fixtures: three ways a restore can fail that must not collapse to one code.
